title: lint: a permission set that declares View All or Modify All on an object beside a readable:false / editable:false entry on that object gets a finding; the mask no longer binds its own holders
body:
domain:server#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmQxwoGb5fSnrFkpxmt

立卡门: ① 已落地工作欠的后续。PR #29387(#29106,裁决 6573563853 字母 A)的合约复审 6579089871 should-fix 2 与增量复审 6580148720 (b) 点名。落点具名，有实测：#29387 修了 2 个仓内测试夹具，就因为这一组合静默失效。
业务理由: 裁决 A 之后，一个权限集如果在同一对象上既声明「查看全部 / 修改全部」又写 `readable: false` / `editable: false`,这个遮罩对持有该集的人不再生效。作者(尤其 AI)写出这种集合时没有任何提示，以为字段藏住了，其实没有。仓里已经有两个夹具这样写过(`resume-decider-identity`、`explain-principal-person`)。还有一个按变量拼出的组合(`admin-ledger-decision-metadata.dogfood.test.ts` 158–180)结构 grep 抓不到，只能靠读规范化后的集合才能发现。不修的话，以后每个这样写的应用都在静默泄露字段。
动手的读者: domain:server 席。在 `packages/lint` 加一条作者期规则：读规范化后的权限集，对象上有超级用户位、又有同对象的 `readable:false` 或 `editable:false` 条目时，出一条 warning,写明哪个位让哪个遮罩失效、怎么改(去掉位改用行级策略，或删掉遮罩)。CLI 与运行时保存/发布的提示都走规则表(`AUTHORING_RULES`)。
查重: `superuser field mask lint viewAllRecords readable false` 3 命中(#29106 本身及无关两张)。没有同类 lint 卡。

Follow-up of: #29106 (PR #29387)

## Acceptance
- One rule in the authoring registry, severity **warning** (never a refusal; the ruling made the pair legal, just inert).
- Read the set as the runtime reads it: the `objects[name] || objects['*']` resolution that `holdsSuperuserBypass` uses (`packages/core/src/security/effective-object-permissions.ts`). The wildcard is included. ⛔ No second reading of "who holds the bypass": import or mirror the core predicate's inputs exactly, and pin the parity.
- `viewAllRecords` beside `readable: false` → finding. `modifyAllRecords` beside `readable: false` or `editable: false` → finding. `viewAllRecords` beside `editable: false` → no finding (View All never grants edit, so that lock still binds).
- Red-first pins plus a control: a set with a row policy and a mask gets nothing.
- Report the census the rule produces over `examples/**`, the showcase and the repo's fixtures.
